segments.text: Stages
Fundamental Stage
Activation of Mantra
In ashaeiynn, an aspirant will learn how to activate a mantra and how to use it.
Activation of Astral Body
In Ashaeiynn, An Aspirant Will Learn How To activate their astral body using specific vidhyas.
Japa synchronisation & utilisation
In Ashaeiynn, An Aspirant Will be able to synchronise their japa in order to activate their mantra.
Activation of 12 Quantum Energy Points
Intermediate Stage​
Activation of Chakras
In Ashaeiynn, An Aspirant Will Learn How To activate their chakras step by step using mantra shakti and their aspects in astral world.
Activation of 3rd eye gets start
80-85% Aspirant’s 3rd Eye Get Activated at this stage.In Ashaeiynn, An Aspirant Will Learn How To learn movements of 3rd eye in astral world.
Activation of Kundalni Shakti
Knowledge of 3rd eye
layer of third Eye, How to use third eye, communication methods using 3rd eye, third eye protection methods
Key for igniting yourself with dev tarang
In Ashaeiynn, An Aspirant Will get a key to ignite the self with the dev tarang (this is a very sacred process).
Tattva Activation
In Ashaeiynn, An Aspirant Will Learn How To activate the mool tattva of the dev loka.
Knowledge of Dimensions
In ashaeiynn, an aspirant will learn how to control anyone’s dimension: increase Anyone’s Dimensions Decrease Anyone’s Dimensions (If Required)
Advanced Stage
Advanced Activation of 3rd eye
In Ashaeiynn, An Aspirant Will Learn How To use 3rd eye as a tool to make changes in physical world.
Getting specialisation degree in your spiritual path
In Ashaeiynn, An Aspirant Will be able to choose their desired trait in the spiritual path so that they can master themself in that particular field.
Enchancinig 3rd eye powers to see both astral & physical world with open eyes
In Ashaeiynn, An Aspirant Will be able to see both astral & physical world with their open eye.
Also an aspirant will be able to parallely see and distinguish between astral & physical world which will give them better opportunity to understand the working of astral world.
enchancing your Professional Life by 3rd eye powers
In Ashaeiynn, An Aspirant Will be able to enhance their professional life by using 3rd eye powers.
Example-
i) An architect can see new architectural designs of the astral world and can bring those in the physical world.
ii) A scientist can do new experiments and innovations.
iii) A Doctor can see live running blood streams in their patients bodies & can detect where the problem lies.
Ultra Stage
Extreme Specialisation and perfection in mantra & accessing all dimensions & functions of the mantra
At this stage, An Aspirant will be more capable to access all dimensions energy & abilities of the mantra.
Can transform any object of astral world into physical world.
In Ashaeiynn, An Aspirant will be able to transform and bring any object of astral world into physical world like our devas & rishis used to.
Control over tattva using KUNDALINI SHAKTI
In Ashaeiynn, An Aspirant will be taught how to:
Control Fire Element
Control Earth Element
using their kundalini shakti & dev tattva.
Control over planets
In Ashaeiynn, An Aspirant will be able to control over planets by combining their tattva energy, kundalini shakti & planetary energy.
Controlling dimensions of anyone's using mantra shakti
In Ashaeiynn, An Aspirant will be able to control anyone’s dimensions by:
Increase Anyone’s Dimensions
Decrease Anyone’s Dimensions (If Required)
Prediction of future
In Ashaeiynn, An Aspirant will be able to predict future by using their 3rd eye powers and mantra shakti. You will also get capability to bring the future time now.
Creating presence of yourself in multiple dimensions at a same time
In Ashaeiynn, An Aspirant will be able to present themself as a physical and astrally in 2 or more than 2 forms at a same time (Clone concept).
Ultra Pro Stage
This will only be disclosed to selected aspirants who will reach at the ultra stage
Once an aspirant reaches to the ultra stage, they will get to know all about of this stage.
